Won from beating Gladiator Event 2019|Inventory Description}} |-|Version 1 = {{QuoteBox|Earned by beating the Gladiator Event|Former Inventory Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Gladiator''' is an exclusive melee ground tower that could have been obtained by triumphing [[The Heights]] during the [[SFOTH Event]], or through limited time gamepases. The '''Gladiator''' swings its sword in an arc, piercing through multiple enemies at once. At Level 2, it unlocks the ''War Cry'' ability; upon activation, it makes it attack much faster by giving it a [[Firerate Buff]], allowing it to deal significantly more damage and deal with stronger threats. Additionally, it removes the [[Fatigue Debuff]] or [[Scared Debuff]] from the '''Gladiator'''. When activating the ability, the '''Gladiator''' will stop attacking enemies for 1.5 seconds. From Level 3, it also unlocks the passive ability ''Fire Aspect''. Once the cooldown bar reaches 0, the next attack will inflict burn on an enemy, dealing damage over time for a short duration. The '''Gladiator''' also has a unique passive ability where it can block stuns, such as attacks from the [[Frost Hero]] or the [[Fallen King]]. During the parry, it stops attacking enemies for 0.75 seconds. It cannot parry other types of attacks, like debuffs or freezes. The '''Gladiator''' has [[Hidden (Attribute)|hidden]] detection from Level 0 and [[Lead (Attribute)|lead]] detection from Level 3. This can effectively handle fast and tough enemies. ***Do note that the ''Warrior's Call'' ability stops the '''Gladiator''' from attacking for a 1.5 seconds when activated. The ability should be used a few seconds before enemies enter the '''Gladiator's''' range. *Towers like the [[Freezer]], [[Tesla]] or [[Sledger]] can be used to slow enemies down, giving more time for the '''Gladiator''' to attack them. *The '''Gladiator's''' capability to hit more than one enemy makes it very efficient against groups of enemies, especially slow ones. Do note that it can only hit a limited number of enemies in one swing. *The '''Gladiator''' struggles against fast enemies, such as the [[Bolt]] and [[Fallen Rusher]], as most often will escape '''Gladiator's''' range very quickly. **Additionally, singular high-health enemy like the [[Speedy Boss]] can easily pass through its range. On the other hand, groups of slow, tough enemies like the [[Slow Boss]] are optimal for the '''Gladiator''' as it can hit a decent number of enemies within its range. **It may become feasible by setting up multiple '''Gladiators''' placed along the path to handle further, more of them. *The '''Gladiator''' has hidden detection from Level 0 onwards, so it can deal with [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemies very early on. *On Level 3 or higher, the '''Gladiator''' gains lead detection, allowing it to handle [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies, especially during early to mid-game. *Because there is a delay where the '''Gladiator''' does not attack for a few seconds after performing the ability, it is useful to use the ability around a second before an enemy enters its range. *The '''Gladiator''' has a small placement footprint, meaning that it can squeeze in beside other towers quite easily. **On top of this, as it lacks a placement limit, it can be placed in high groups around a corner, which due to their high DPS and AOE allows them to clear out hordes of enemies quite easily. ==Trivia== [[File:MedievalTimesGladiatorVacation.png|thumb|Level 0 '''Gladiator''' seen farming in the 2nd & 3rd versions of [[Medieval Times]].|282x282px]] *When the '''Gladiator''' was first added, its upgrade stats were not displayed on its upgrade description. It was simply referred to as "sans sword". *The '''Gladiator''' could have been seen in the second and third versions of [[Medieval Times]] farming in front of a house, supposedly on vacation. **This was due to the fact that the '''Gladiator''' was unusable between the 13th of October 2019 and the 29th of November 2019. ***Attempting to place the '''Gladiator''' resulted in the following message being displayed: "''Hey! I'm on vacation, don't bother me!''". **This Easter egg was still in the game, despite the '''Gladiator''' being usable again, though it would be removed on the 4th of February 2023 when [[Medieval Times]] was remade. *Prior to the 29th of November 2019, the '''Gladiator''' had two abilities: ''Frenzy'' and ''Sharp Edge''. **''Frenzy'' was the original name for ''Warrior's Call''. **''Sharp Edge'' increased damage by 100% for 8 seconds, having a 60-second cooldown between each use. *Prior to the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]] and the [[Medic]]'s addition to the game, the '''Gladiator''' was the only tower that was able to heal base health. **At Level 5, the '''Gladiator''' healed +1 health per kill (for base health). This was, however, removed on the 29th of November 2019. *The '''Gladiator''' used to have four main attacks after the 29th of November 2019. Each attack was chosen at random prior to the 26th of May 2020. **The first one was a simple ''Sword Slash''. This hit the least number of enemies. **The second one was a ''Sword Spin''. This made the '''Gladiator''' spin around 360 degrees, damaging any enemies in the said area. **The third was the ''Piercing Lunge'', which could be unlocked at Level 4. As the name suggests, the '''Gladiator''' lunged forward to deal damage to any enemy within range. **The fourth was the ''Sharp Dash'', which could be unlocked at Level 5. The '''Gladiator''' quickly dashed forward, and did an attack similar to the ''Piercing Lunge'', but it affected more enemies as the range was increased. This affected the most enemies. *This was the first event tower to be added to the game. *Upon being hit by the '''Gladiator''', enemies will emit blood particles. *The [[v2.7.0]] rework has went through a few mechanical changes before release which can be seen through various developer descriptions of its mechanics. **The first is ''Blood Strike'', an ability which was directly replaced by ''Fire Aspect''[[File:GladiatorBloodStrikeProof.png|280px]]
https://discord.com/channels/735394249863987241/1514661298409836714/1540048905339674634 (Tower Defense Simulator Wiki Server) was the early version of ''Fire Aspect'', applying bleed rather than burn in a similar manner it does so currently.https://discord.com/channels/587355301083349002/600908514847883294/1540833875486576680 (Tower Defense Simulator Server) **The tower appears to have originally been able to support other towers through its ''War Cry'', as such mechanic has been mentioned at many points by the developers.[[File:GladiatorSupportProof.png|280px]]
https://discord.com/channels/587355301083349002/664997359071002637/1540390256774488094 (Tower Defense Simulator Server) Although the '''Gladiator''' can apply a buff to itself and cleanse some debuffs from itself, it is not able to buff other towers. ***This was scrapped due to the ability being useless and not fitting very well with the tower's design.https://discord.com/channels/587355301083349002/892156782347161690/1540475542468304988 (Tower Defense Simulator Server) **The update log for [[v2.7.0]] mentions that ''War Cry'' has a 50% boost to range.[[File:GladiatorRangeBuffProof.png|280px]]
